name: Daniel Davenport

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Mary Nesbitt (b. Plymouth 3 Mar 1803); seven children.

events.title: Built a sawmill with John Lamoreaux
events.place: Bidlack's Creek, Jackson Twp., Luzerne Co.

bioAdditions: Giles & Franklin say Daniel was born at Plymouth on 7 or 9 March 1796 or 1797, died on 3 Sep 1840, and married Mary Nesbitt (b. Plymouth 3 Mar 1803) on 12 Mar 1820. Their children were Charles (b. 27 May 1821), George (4 Jan 1823 - 27 Jun 1906, m. Emily Ingham), Chester (b. 7 Feb 1825, d. Dec 1855), Esther (b. 14 May 1827, m. William Garrahan), Harriet (b. 2 Apr 1830), James (b. 3 May 1831) and Hendrick Wright Davenport (b. 6 Dec 1834, d. Culbertson, Neb., 9 Jul 1916) (S1). The youngest was evidently named for H. B. Wright, who sat on the same school bench as Daniel. In 1823 Daniel and John Lamoreaux built a sawmill on Bidlack's Creek (S2).

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Family genealogy with exact dates, consistent with Wright.

sources.citation: Giles & Franklin, Thomas Davenport ... and his Descendants (1962), pp.320-321
sources.supports: birth, death 3 Sep 1840, marriage 12 Mar 1820 to Mary Nesbitt, seven children
